section: One Time Registration and scholarship application
text: The National Scholarship Portal student page says One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory for applying for scholarships on NSP. OTR is a unique 14-digit number based on the student's Aadhaar number or Aadhaar Enrolment ID and remains applicable throughout the student's academic career. After obtaining an OTR, the student logs in with the OTR ID and password to fill a fresh or renewal scholarship application and to check its status. Scheme eligibility, opening dates and closing dates must be checked on the current NSP scheme listing before applying.
title: National Scholarship Portal - OTR and student application
